caption: MCP List Roots Result
description:
The client's response to a roots/list request from the server.
This result contains an array of Root objects, each representing a root directory
or file that the server can operate on. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ListRootsResult; 2026-07-28 ListRootsResult).
